init_hook: [ -d scripts/playground-gate/node_modules/jsdom ] || npm --prefix scripts/playground-gate ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "devbox: jsdom install for test-playground-mermaid failed — run: npm --prefix scripts/playground-gate ci"

scripts.setup: git submodule update --init --recursive && make -C third_party/v && make build-vcx && make check-v-fork && vcx/target/cx --version
scripts.baseline: start=$(date +%s); sh scripts/gate.sh; echo "BASELINE $(tail -1 vcx/target/gate.log) elapsed $(( ($(date +%s) - start) / 60 )) min on $(hostname -s) at $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.runner: mkdir -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents && cp scripts/runner/ai.cx.gate-loop.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.cx.gate-loop.plist && launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.cx.gate-loop | grep -E 'state|pid'
scripts.runner-status: launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.cx.gate-loop | grep -E 'state|pid'; tail -3 vcx/target/gate-loop.log
